name: cache-clock
description: Counts down the session's prompt-cache lifetime above the prompt and keeps it warm on demand with /keepwarm.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn cache-clock on or off; off unloads its hooks until turned back on.

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: auto: 5 minutes when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, else 1 hour (subscriptions).

auto_keepwarm.title: Keep warm automatically
auto_keepwarm.description: Ping just before the cache expires while the session is idle. Each ping is billed.

max_auto_pings.title: Automatic pings per idle stretch
max_auto_pings.description: How many automatic pings in a row before letting the cache go cold.
